title: Moodboard opens automatically when empty
reproduction: Open or reload the extension when no moodboard elements exist and observe whether the moodboard opens by itself.
likely_investigation: Check moodboard visibility state initialization, persistence, and any automatic-open logic triggered when the item collection is empty.
acceptance_criteria: The moodboard remains closed unless explicitly opened by the user, and it opens reliably when explicitly requested.

title: Verify notes functionality
reproduction: Create, edit, save, reopen, and search notes on tabs, including notes on closed or previously navigated tabs.
likely_investigation: Review note creation, persistence, rendering, editing, and search behavior across active and closed/history nodes.
acceptance_criteria: Notes can be created, edited, persisted across reloads, displayed correctly, and found by search without data loss.
